title: Welcome and first run
goal: Choose a source without implying that enabling the plugin starts a scan.

title: Choose a codebase source
goal: Select current vault, a vault directory, or an external local directory.

title: Review scope and read access
goal: Understand the resolved root and exclusions before starting a read-only inventory.

title: Scan progress and cancellation
goal: Know what is happening, cancel safely, and retain previous complete results.

title: Structural city — dark
goal: Orient to directory districts and inspect the shape of a codebase.

title: Structural city — light
goal: See the same source, layout, and selection through the host light theme.

title: File selection and inspector
goal: Select a building and read exact file measurements.

title: Search and filtered context
goal: Find a path without destroying the spatial context.

title: Top-down orientation
goal: Inspect overlapping districts without depending on orbit gestures.

title: Narrow leaf and inspector drawer
goal: Complete the same tasks in a narrow desktop workspace leaf.

title: Accessible list and 3D fallback
goal: Continue inspection when 3D is unavailable or deliberately not used.

title: Cancelled scan with previous snapshot
goal: Understand that a cancelled run has not replaced a complete snapshot.

title: Native settings and profiles
goal: Manage source scope, exclusions, and storage without a second application shell.

title: Connect fallow evidence
goal: Choose report import or explicit execution of an already installed analyzer.

title: Fallow findings lens
goal: Distinguish reported findings from unavailable measurements.

title: Dependency neighborhood
goal: Read direction and investigate a bounded set of actual dependency edges.

title: Finding investigation workbench
goal: Investigate the selected finding using provenance and evidence.

title: Create investigation note
goal: Preview a deliberate Markdown note write without changing source code.

title: Compare compatible snapshots
goal: Compare evidence without reshuffling the city or hiding incompatibilities.

title: Coverage with unknown evidence
goal: Distinguish measured zero coverage from unavailable coverage.

title: Explainable overview
goal: Prioritize investigation through explicit signals rather than a synthetic score.

title: Provider failure and retained evidence
goal: Recover a failed provider while keeping the structural city usable.

title: No matching files
goal: Recover from a filter that hides all files without mistaking it for an empty repository.

title: Investigation note and focused city
goal: Navigate from notes to a pinned, focused snapshot without authorizing a scan.

title: Diagnostics and security evidence
goal: Separate package advisories from source diagnostics and exploitability claims.

title: Bundle contribution
goal: Inspect shipped bytes without conflating them with source size or runtime speed.

title: CI artifacts and explicit watch
goal: Import results and authorize a bounded watch session explicitly.

title: Runtime observation window
goal: Distinguish not observed, not instrumented, and unmapped execution evidence.
